properties.description: **Essential** — Baseline hygiene for Internet of Things: the non-negotiable controls every deployment should enforce from day one. This tier delivers RBAC and managed-identity controls eliminating shared credentials and TLS / HTTPS enforcement preventing in-transit interception. Together these policies protect against credential theft, unencrypted data exposure, and accidental data loss. Maps to CIS Benchmarks, ISO 27001 Annex A.10 (cryptography) and A.12 (operations).

metadata.policyName: Azure IoT Hub should have local authentication methods disabled for Service Apis
Configure Azure IoT Hub to disable local authentication
